Free play

Start the round and watch which coloured, numbered buttons light up. When it is your turn, press the same buttons in the same order. Complete five sequences. Pause whenever you need; there is no response timer.

How to play+
  1. Start the round and watch which coloured, numbered buttons light up.
  2. When it is your turn, press the same buttons in the same order.
  3. Complete five sequences. Pause whenever you need; there is no response timer.
Tips and tricks+

A few ideas that make Sequence Memory easier and more fun:

  • Break long sequences into chunks of two or three instead of one long line.
  • Tap or hum along while the pads light up. Rhythm helps memory more than you would expect.
  • Turn the sound on. Every pad has its own note, and a short melody is easier to remember than a list.
About Sequence Memory+

Play Sequence Memory online

Watch-and-repeat games have been childhood favourites for generations. This version uses four coloured, numbered buttons and gradually longer patterns.

Why it works+

You keep a short sequence in mind and reproduce its order. The task uses working memory, sustained attention and coordination between seeing and pressing.

These are the skills used during play; improvement outside the game is not established.
